title: Series composition
caption: Components in series add their failure rates. The prorated per-GPU share of node-level hardware divides a node-wide rate by the GPUs per node, and redundant supplies contribute zero until one failure alone can kill the node.

symbols.meaning: GPU failure rate = 1/MTTF = 2.0 x 10^-5 per hour at 50,000 h
PCIe link failure rate, comparable order
per-GPU share of node power failures; 0 under 4+2 redundancy
per-GPU share of NIC/cable failure rate (node rate / 8 GPUs)

title: System MTBF
caption: Fleet failure rate is the per-GPU total times the device count; the reciprocal is the mean time between failures. 10,000 GPUs at ~3.9e-5 per hour each give a failure every ~3.9 hours; the GPU-only simplification (50,000/10,000) gives 5 hours.

symbols.meaning: accelerators in the cluster (10,000 in the running example)
system failure rate, ~0.26 failures/hour for the cascade
expected hours between failures: ~3.9 h full-system, 5 h GPU-only

title: Young-Daly interval
caption: The checkpoint interval minimizing expected waste: save too often and write time dominates, too rarely and expected replay dominates. At the optimum the two terms are equal — 24.5 s write at 3.9 h MTBF gives ~14 minutes.

symbols.meaning: optimal checkpoint interval (~14 min here, ~15.7 min for the 175B archetype)
time to durably write one checkpoint (~24.5 s at 100 GB/s for 2.45 TB)
the cluster MTBF the run actually experiences

title: Recovery time decomposition
caption: A failure's cost is the sum of noticing it, replacing the resource, reloading state, and refilling pipelines. The reference budget: ~30 s + ~4 min + ~24.5 s + ~2 min = ~6.6 min per incident.

symbols.meaning: physical fault to system classification (~30 s)
scheduler allocates + launches replacements + rendezvous (~4 min, the dominant term)
aggregate checkpoint read into GPU memory (~24.5 s)
pipeline refill, JIT compile, throughput stabilization (~2 min)

title: Replica availability
caption: Parallel composition for serving: independent replicas compound availability exponentially. At 99% per replica the annual downtime falls 3.65 days -> 52.6 minutes -> 31.5 seconds for 1, 2, 3 replicas, but only if failures are independent and survivors can absorb the load.

symbols.meaning: single-replica availability (0.99 in the worked ladder)
replica count in independent failure domains
probability at least one replica is serving

title: Straggler step time
caption: In synchronous training the slowest rank sets the step for everyone. One half-speed GPU on a 1,024-GPU job halves total throughput (~\$1,024/hour idle), while passing every liveness check — the straggler is invisible to heartbeat detection.

symbols.meaning: rank i's compute contribution to the step
collective time at N devices
worker count
